description: MS6 closing proof: sensorless 400->800 rad/s el running on the profiler-measured, protocol-applied parameters (R 0.904, L 28 uH, psi 0.888 mWb, J-derived speed gains). Handoff transient shrank from 1316 to 527 rad/s peak and step overshoot from 9.7 to 4.8 percent vs the hand-guessed gains.
notes: Captured live from mmc-g474 (BoardG474) over mmc-proto; 9440 frames.
title: Validation: sensorless on applied profile (400 to 800)
